messages:
sophia: Quick heads-up — we're planning to ship the audit event additions (kms_key_id, rbac_action, principal_type) tomorrow morning. Need a final sanity check before customer preview.
rahul: Thanks. Do we have a concise mapping doc for existing SIEM customers? want to make sure field names are stable.
sophia: Yes — added a draft mapping in the docs PR. main concern: `principal_id` will become optional when `principal_type` is present. back-compat note included.
jamie: Also flagging: some customers expect `user.email` in the audit envelope. we're not adding emails to events by default for privacy, but we can provide an enriched-offer.
marcus: +1 on privacy. For those who need it, we should document the opt-in telemetry flag and KMS implications for PII.
sec-bot: Incident check: last 30d we had one alert for malformed audit payloads during canary, traced to a deployment with v2-beta encoder.
rahul: Good catch. Are we gating rollout behind canary and schema validation?
sophia: Yes — staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with schema validation hook. If invalid payloads > 0.5% we auto-rollback.
ajex: (typo) sorry, ignore
alex: Quick question on KMS field: `kms_key_id` — is that the customer KMS ARN or an internal alias? need to clarify for customers.
sophia: It will be the customer-managed KMS key identifier (ARN for AWS). For HSM/KMS we include a string identifier only — no secrets.
jamie: Can we add an example audit event snippet for docs? customers often want a JSON sample.
sophia: sure — adding this to the PR. snippet:```json
{
  "event_type": "config.update",
  "timestamp": "2025-02-18T09:12:33Z",
  "principal_type": "service_account",
  "principal_id": "svc-1234",
  "rbac_action": "role.grant",
  "resource": "project:acme-app",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
}
```
marcus: Looks good. For customer comms we should include a short changelog line + migration steps: mapping table, example SIEM query, and opt-in instructions for `include_user_email` flag.
rahul: I'll draft the SIEM query examples (Splunk/Elastic). Will also add a migration note: `principal_id` -> `principal.identifier` for enriched events.
sophia: Thanks. Also validating RBAC implications: adding `rbac_action` means downstream policy engines can be more precise, but we must avoid leaking internal role names. we'll post a redaction guide.
jamie: Vulnerability triage note: if KMS key identifiers are present in logs, threat model says they are low-sensitivity but still monitor access patterns. add to SOC playbook.
sec-bot: Security checklist status: schema docs, changelog entry, customer-preview email draft, SIEM mappings — all flagged as "needs review".
sophia: Can everyone review the PR and the customer preview email by EOD? I'll schedule a dry-run with support tomorrow 10am.
alex: Reviewed the PR — left one comment about `principal_type` enum values.
marcus: I'll handle the support dry-run invite and include legal for the email copy.
rahul: PR review in progress. will push Splunk queries shortly.
sophia: Awesome — thanks team. We'll wait for signoffs then start canary at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
